== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Jai]] clan, also known as the [[Jai]] family, is a prominent and proud faction within the [[Blackflame Empire]]. Originally emerging from the barbaric groups of the [[Desolate Wilds]], they rose to power through their mastery of light-aspected combat techniques on the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]]. While they have historically unified the region through violent rule, they have established themselves as a first-class clan with significant influence. The clan's main branch is located in the [[Blackflame Empire]], while various branches and outposts exist elsewhere, such as a branch comparable to the [[Purelake Temple]] in influence. The clan is led by an [[Underlord]] Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch, a legendary figure who transformed the group from a remote wilderness clan into an [[Imperial]] power. However, the clan faces internal instability due to the aging of its leader and a history of rebellion from disenfranchised branch families who practiced warped versions of their [[sacred arts]]. One notable instance involved a failed uprising that led to the exile of [[Jai Long]], a highly talented member, to the [[Desolate Wilds]]. In recent history, the clan's reputation has suffered following aggressive actions against the [[Arelius family]]. This conflict led to the clan being pushed out of The Empire{{!}}the Empire's core, causing them to seek new settlements on its borders. Despite these challenges and shifting political standings, the [[Jai]] clan remains a formidable force characterized by regimented ranks of warriors wielding [[white light]] and specialized spear techniques.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Originating in the [[Desolate Wilds]], the legendary [[Jai]] clan moved their main branch to the [[Blackflame Empire]] after producing an [[Underlord]]. As a first-class clan within the empire, they are part of the [[Alliance camp]] and maintain an alliance with the [[Sandviper sect]]. The group follows the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], utilizing light-aspected combat techniques and specific spear movements represented by a twisting line of starlight. Although [[Jai Sen]] attempted to recruit [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] to work for the clan, they avoided staying with them. The clan possesses a spear with specific binding{{!}}bindings and includes figures such as [[Jai Long]], who holds status within the group despite being formerly of the clan.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The ancient [[Jai]] clan, led by Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch [[Jai Daishou]], maintains a presence at the border and operates palaces on the mountain peak in [[Serpent's Grave]]. Comprised of refiners, [[Soulsmiths]], Highgold{{!}}Highgolds, and Lowgold{{!}}Lowgolds, the clan is identified by their black hair, sky blue robes, and a star-and-spear emblem. Their warriors are equipped for battle using tall spears and generational spear arts, including the [[Star Lance]] [[technique]]. After seizing assets from [[Eithan]]'s family and the last refinery in Serpent's Grave{{!}}Serpent’s Grave, the clan nearly declared war before slowing their aggression due to a guerilla war waged by [[Jai Long]] and the [[Sandvipers]]. While they reclaim territory with ruthless efficiency, they have also begun hunting anyone wearing a black crescent.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The [[Jai]] clan is a great family whose territory encompasses a lake and miles of underground tunnels. Although [[Jai Daishou]] desires for his clan to outlive him, they are currently the lowest-ranked of the great clans and are crumbling in the west. The clan has previously exiled [[Jai Long]] to the [[Desolate Wilds]], and they are a group to whom [[Lindon]] mentions sending ashes. Furthermore, the clan's net is something that characters intend to escape.}}
